name: Lethean-Bergschrund
description: Rock deserts and sand seas take turns under a sky like hammered brass. Between dust events the wind redraws solar wind erosion patterns, patient as erosion itself.
Storm season reorganizes all plans. When the pressure falls, animals go quiet, instruments drift, and the horizon turns the color of an old wound.
Whoever abandoned the ancient alien ruins did so in order: power first, then data, then people. The airlocks were cycled from the inside, gently, one last time.
The artifact market prices fragments from this world like scripture. Provenance papers are forged in three systems, badly.
